name: illustration-globe-vercel
title: Deploy Globe
description: A half-globe drawn in thin lines, with coloured paths that travel from the north pole down to small circular nodes and ring out as they land. A small badge underneath reports whether the deploy is running, done or failed.
use: A deploy or infrastructure section needs a compact visual of routes reaching nodes with a pass or fail state.
avoid: It is decoration, not data: paths are fixed trajectories and the wireframe density is hardcoded.
a11y: The drawing is aria-hidden and the replay button has a label, but nothing checks reduced-motion and the button has no visible focus style. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A faint grey hemisphere on a near-black stage, made of one round outline, several vertical meridians and nine latitude lines. Six small circles sit at path endpoints, and a compact light pill with a status word and replay icon is centred below the globe.
behaves: Accent-coloured paths draw themselves from the pole down to each node in turn, and a circle at each landing point swells into a fading ring. The status pill can read deploying, deployed or failed, and its replay icon restarts the whole sequence.
customise: Status, accent colour, duration, the node list and a replay callback are props; the globe geometry and wireframe density are fixed constants.
weight: light: A few dozen SVG lines animated by SMIL opacity and radius; no canvas, WebGL or JS frame loop.
